title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts: Batch-Size Points for Wrong-Address Violations
content:
A wrong-address violation on Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts starts from batch-size points, which follow the number of orders on the batch that carried the order handed to the wrong address.

**Which batch.** The batch is the one named on the batch pay reversal recorded in the Cartwise Shopper Batches pay ledger for an order verified as not delivered; its order count is read from that batch's record.

**Rule.** On a batch of three or more orders the batch-size points are half of the level's wrong-address points, rounded down to a whole point; on a batch of two orders they are the level's wrong-address points less one point; on a single-order batch they are the full wrong-address points. The level's wrong-address points are 3 points at each of the six levels of the violation point schedule.

## Ladder

| Orders on the batch | Rule | Batch-size points with the schedule's 3 points |
|---|---|---|
| Three or more | Half, rounded down to a whole point | 1 point (half of 3 is 1.5, rounded down) |
| Two | Less one point | 2 points |
| One | The full figure | 3 points |

## Input — judgement — output (hypothetical batches)

- A Triple Delivery Batch whose pay was reversed for one undelivered order: three orders, half of 3 rounded down — 1 point.
- A Double Delivery Batch: two orders — 3 points less 1, that is 2 points.
- A Single Delivery Batch: one order — 3 points.

The rounding is downward: 1.5 becomes 1.
